integrity: For \(p>3\), self-orthogonality is proved from scalar invariance of the defining set and exact vanishing of first and second moments. The exceptional prime \(p=3\) is handled by the source's full ternary weight enumerator and polarization. The unpunctured hull follows exactly from the source's extra coordinate \(\operatorname{Tr}(b)\). Standalone finite-field replay verifies the construction at \(p=3\) and \(p=7\).
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the Section 4 extension-degree-three trace-quadric family for primes \(p\equiv3\pmod4\). It does not classify hulls of all subfield-code families in the source, and it makes no quantum optimality claim.
title: Exact Euclidean hulls of the \(p^3\) trace-quadric subfield codes
